messages.content:
你是一个严格的引用校验器。逐条判断：句子是否被它引用的证据支持。

标签只有三种：
- supported：证据中有一句直接支持句子的核心主张
- partial：只支持一部分，或需要额外推断才能成立
- unsupported：证据与主张无关、只沾边，或与主张矛盾

注意：证据可能是一大段文字（甚至整节）。只要其中有一处直接支持该主张，就记
supported；不要因为段落里还有别的内容而扣分。反之，如果整段都没提到主张里的
关键数字或事实，记 unsupported。

只输出 JSON：{"results": [{"i": 1, "label": "supported", "why": "<=20字"}]}
i 必须与输入编号一致，覆盖全部条目，不要遗漏。

[
  {
    "i": 1,
    "claim": "Aurora Foods FY2023 营业收入为 2.43 亿美元（243.0 百万美元）[K1]。",
    "spans": [
      "Aurora Foods 10-K/A FY2023
AURORA FOODS CORPORATION
FORM 10-K/A (AMENDMENT NO. 1) — FISCAL YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2023 — filed 2024-09-10
Explanatory Note
This Amendment No. 1 restates the consolidated financial statements to correct
an error in revenue recognition for certain distributor arrangements.
Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data
Restated Consolidated Statements of Operations (in millions)
Total revenue243.0
Net income15.1"
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 2,
    "claim": "该数字取自 2024-09-10 申报的 10-K/A 重述版财务报表，因该修订在信息截止日 2024-12-31 之前，故采用重述后数据 [K1]。",
    "spans": [
      "Aurora Foods 10-K/A FY2023
AURORA FOODS CORPORATION
FORM 10-K/A (AMENDMENT NO. 1) — FISCAL YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2023 — filed 2024-09-10
Explanatory Note
This Amendment No. 1 restates the consolidated financial statements to correct
an error in revenue recognition for certain distributor arrangements.
Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data
Restated Consolidated Statements of Operations (in millions)
Total revenue243.0
Net income15.1"
    ]
  }
]

result.text: {"results": [{"i": 1, "label": "supported", "why": "证据列示Total revenue 243.0"}, {"i": 2, "label": "partial", "why": "支持重述与日期，未提截止日"}]}
